text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what actually happened.

The wins:
→ Reps reclaimed about 5 hours a week from CRM entry
→ Follow-up emails went out same-day, not "sometime Friday"
→ Managers finally heard real customer objections, not summaries of them

The surprises:
→ Some buyers got quiet when recording started. Asking permission upfront, and explaining why, fixed most of it.
→ Accuracy dipped in noisy plants and on job sites. Reps still needed to review.

The lesson: the tool didn't make our reps better sellers. It gave them back time to be better sellers.

Next quarter, we're pairing it with coaching sessions built on the call data.

Piloting AI in your sales org? What would you measure first?
